description: 80-dps Perturbative QFT Subsumption Probe (Zero Fitting, Zero Float64): (1) 12-digit electron anomalous magnetic moment a_e = (g-2)_e/2 from exact analytical universal QED coefficients (C_1, C_2, C_3) + 4/5-loop QED + QOU-derived 2-loop muon vacuum polarization across all four QOU alpha_EM^-1 branches vs. Harvard-2023, Rubidium-2020, and Cesium-2018; (2) 2-loop running strong coupling alpha_s(Q^2) with continuous threshold matching across m_c, m_b, m_t from all four QOU hadronic candidate scales; and (3) non-perturbative 3-strand Borromean proton [u,u,d] in H_3(q) valence Mellin moments evolved via 1-loop non-singlet and singlet (q_Sigma, g) 2x2 matrix DGLAP equations from mu_0 = m_p to Q^2 = 4 GeV^2, 100 GeV^2, and M_Z^2.

harvard_2023_experiment.reference: Fan et al. (2023), Phys. Rev. Lett. 130, 071801

pin_and_branch_uniqueness_audit.open_gap_1_dyson_uniqueness_form_B_vs_fo: OPEN: Must derive from the 1PI Bring-Schwinger photon Dyson equation why the Habiro self-dressing factor (1 - h^2 alpha) in Form B (1/alpha = T + alpha H (1 - h^2 alpha), +2.37 sigma at q_0) is uniquely required over the bare 1-loop self-energy Form A (1/alpha = T + alpha H, -9.73 sigma at q_0).
pin_and_branch_uniqueness_audit.open_gap_2_q0_vs_q2t_pin_shift_and_2loop: OPEN: Moving from the 1-term proton pin q_0 (which absorbs the proton +0.220 keV Borromean V^3 QED self-energy) to the QED-subtracted 2-term Borromean proton pin q_2t (+11.17 ppb in q) or ideal CAL-2 muon pin q_muon (+11.61 ppb in q) shifts 1/alpha_EM by +0.000010461 (+76.34 ppb, -677.5 sigma on a_e), exposing an un-derived -1.939 (alpha/pi)^2 (2-loop Schwinger-Jost-Luttinger photon vacuum polarization / Bloch-group Delta_2) offset at the canonical QED-subtracted pin.

data.methodology_note: UV-to-IR Division of Labour & Candid Open-Gap Accounting: QOU provides discrete ultraviolet spectral boundary conditions at the hadronic/threshold scale (alpha_EM^-1, m_mu/m_e, m_pi, m_p, and the 3-strand Borromean Jucys-Murphy strand weights in H_3(q)), while standard continuum 3+1D QED Schwinger-Petermann-Laporta series, 2-loop QCD beta-function evolution, and 1-loop Altarelli-Parisi (DGLAP) anomalous dimensions govern infrared momentum-scale running. No parameter is fitted; all candidate branches and pins are reported side-by-side alongside three explicit structural open gaps: (1) In Part 1, while Form-B (1/alpha = T + alpha H (1 - h^2 alpha)) at the 1-term proton pin q_0 yields alpha_EM^-1 = 137.035999127 (+2.37 sigma vs. Harvard 2023 a_e, strictly between Rb-2020 and Cs-2018), moving to the QED-subtracted 2-term Borromean proton pin q_2t (+11.17 ppb in q) or ideal CAL-2 muon pin q_muon (+11.61 ppb in q) shifts 1/alpha_EM by +0.000010461 (+76.34 ppb, -677.5 sigma on a_e) due to the tree-level sensitivity d(1/alpha)/dq = +843.64, exposing an un-derived -1.939 (alpha/pi)^2 (2-loop Schwinger-Jost-Luttinger photon vacuum-polarization / Bloch-group Delta_2) offset at q_2t as well as the open Dyson uniqueness proof selecting Form-B over bare Form-A (-9.73 sigma at q_0). (2) In Part 2, a physical hadronic scale at mu ~ 200 MeV resides in the n_f = 3 regime where empirical Lambda_{MSbar}^{(3)} = 356.95 MeV (so identifying (3/2) m_pi = 209.36 MeV with Lambda^{(3)} yields alpha_s(M_Z) = 0.1075), whereas (3/2) m_pi matches Lambda_{MSbar}^{(5)} = 211.89 MeV (alpha_s(M_Z) = 0.1178, -0.24 sigma from PDG 0.1180(9)) only under the 5-flavour threshold-matched MSbar identification. (3) In Part 3, under the pure-valence boundary assumption M_2^{sea}(mu_0) = 0, the initial carry M_2^{val}(mu_0) = 1/[2]_q = 0.4973 reproduces empirical DIS/lattice valence moments at Q^2 = 4 GeV^2 (<x>_{u_v} = 0.3197, <x>_{d_v} = 0.1334, <x>_{u_v - d_v} = 0.1863) while over-assigning the remaining neutral momentum to gluons (<x>_g(4 GeV^2) = 0.5167 vs. empirical 0.41-0.47), whereas M_2^{val}(mu_0) = z_D = 0.6127 reproduces <x>_g(4 GeV^2) = 0.4179 because z_D - 1/[2]_q = 0.1154 proxies the non-perturbative primordial quark sea at mu_0 = m_p.

q0AnchorReason: Evaluates 12-digit electron (g-2)_e across QOU alpha_EM^-1 branches, 2-loop QCD running alpha_s(Q^2), and Borromean proton DIS valence Mellin moments across 1-term proton (q_0), 2-term Borromean proton (q_2t), and ideal CAL-2 muon (q_muon) pins.
